english.title: Driver failing to carry driver's record book

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), whilst on duty as a driver, failed to have your current driver's record book (including all unused record sheets) in your possession at all times
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 10 of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
